Maya Chen: Triage sync for the metering postmortem follow-up. We need firm owners and dates for: root cause fix, ledger backfill, invoice corrections/credits, alerts, and recurrence audit. Short replies with owner + ETA please.

Arjun Patel: I'll take the root cause and consumer fix. Found that the write-retry loop to our token-ingest DB caused backlog. Plan: add capped retries + DLQ. Canary tomorrow AM, full rollout Thu.

Renee Ortiz: I can own invoice corrections and credit ops. Need backfill CSV with original vs corrected token counts and invoice IDs. Draft credit policy: auto-credit > $150 delta, CS review otherwise. ETA: templates by Wed EOD, apply corrections Fri morning.

Maya Chen: Backfill owner? Need runbook, dry-run, and rollback plan.

Arjun Patel: I'll run the backfill tool. Will add --dry-run that emits a reconciliation CSV. Staging dry-run tonight on 10 accounts. Production window Thu 23:30-03:30 UTC.

ops-bot: Incident MET-2025-03-28 logged. Ticket #TKT-3001. Backfill window scheduled Thu 23:30-03:30 UTC.

Renee Ortiz: Finance request: tag corrected invoices with "metering-correction" and include TKT-3001 in memo. Also add a line item "metering adjustment" for auditability.

Arjun Patel: Alerts: added metric metering.ingest.backlog.p95 > 800 triggers; pager to eng-oncall; short runbook in PR 533.

Maya Chen: Recurrence analysis: Arjun, can you run a 30-day scan for backlog spikes and post a chart? If recurring, we escalate to infra for DB rate-limits.

Arjun Patel: On it. Preliminary: two low-volume spikes in last 30 days. Full chart by EOD.

Maya Chen: Summary owners/ETAs:
- Root cause & consumer patch: Arjun 6; canary tomorrow AM, rollout Thu
- Backfill tool + staging dry-run: Arjun 6 tonight; prod run Thu 23:30 UTC
- Runback/backfill execution: Arjun exec + Renee finance signoff Thu night
- Invoice corrections & credits: Renee 6 templates Wed EOD, corrections Fri AM
- Alerts & runbook: Arjun 6 merged
- 14-day rolling audit: Maya to start after backfill, weekly check-ins

Renee Ortiz: Acknowledged. Will prep templates and CS notifications.

Arjun Patel: Staging dry-run passed. Sending CSV to Renee. Ready for production window.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If anything slips, post here. We'll close postmortem once invoices corrected and 14-day audit shows no regressions. :white_check_mark:
